title: Release engineering meeting notes - 2026-06-16
content:
Attendees: Priya Patel (owner), Alex Morgan, Daniel Chen, Samira Gomez, Liam O'Connor, Noor Singh (SRE), Ben Ruiz (PM - Dedicated)

Agenda:
- Release train status and schedule (2026-06-30 train)
- Hotfix status and RCA follow-up (hotfix-2026-06-14)
- Changelog items for next release (breaking/migration notes)
- Rollout strategy and canary plan (region staging)
- Action items and blockers

1) Release train (2026-06-30)
- Current scope: v1.12 release (internal name: bluejay). Major items lined up:
  - Runtime kernel selection improvements (PR #987) - Alex lead, aiming for performance gains on A100 and H100.
  - Autoscaling policy v2 (infra PR #1123) - Daniel + SRE testing; targets: lower cold-start and avoid overprovisioning.
  - Rollout: scheduled canary start 2026-06-28 02:00 UTC, gradual ramp to 20% by 06:00 UTC, full ramp 2026-06-30.
- Risks/Notes:
  - Kernel selection change may cause small latency regression on very short sequences (<16 tokens). Perf tests show 5-8ms regression in p50 for sequence=8. Mitigation: enable regression guard that pins old kernel for short sequences during rollout.
  - Autoscaler change depends on infra config that still needs approval from cloud-ops (pending).
- Decision: keep kernel selection opt-in for the first canary wave; enable by default in wave 2 if metrics are stable.

2) Hotfix follow-up: hotfix-2026-06-14 (memory leak in multi-tenant batching)
- Summary: a memory leak was triggered by a rare path in KV cache eviction when requests were canceled concurrently. Caused elevated memory use on a small number of Dedicated nodes.
- Status: patch deployed 2026-06-14 11:30 UTC; observed stabilization by 14:00 UTC. No customer-facing downtime; two Dedicated customers experienced degraded latency for ~45m.
- Root cause: race condition in eviction code when request-cancel and block-merge occurred simultaneously. See PR and RCA: JIRA-RE-4321.
- Follow-up actions:
  - Daniel to open a unit-test suite that simulates concurrent cancellation + eviction (owner: Daniel Chen, due 2026-06-23).
  - Add metric/alert for eviction-ratelimit-high (owner: Noor Singh, due 2026-06-20).
  - Customer outreach: CS sent summary to affected customers; product to follow up with detailed technical postmortem (owner: Ben Ruiz, due 2026-06-18).

3) Changelog / notable changes for v1.12 (what to call out in release notes)
- Performance: kernel-selection heuristics for MQA and split-attention models (opt-in first wave).
- Reliability: KV cache eviction fix and stronger cancellation guards (hotfix backported).
- Infra: autoscaler v2 with new burst-capacity policy (experimental flag).
- API: streaming improvements to reduce partial-chunk latency (~10% improvement) and new error codes for quota-exceeded on embedded batching.
- Breaking/migration notes: none urgent, but note that customers with custom autoscaling configs may need to validate policies due to the new burst-capacity fields. Provide migration guide link (Confluence doc reference: CONFLUENCE-RELEASE-PLANS-2026-06).

4) Rollout & monitoring plan
- Canary waves:
  - Wave 0 (internal): 2026-06-27 23:00 UTC - internal traffic only (perf benchmarks + SRE canaries).
  - Wave 1 (beta customers): 2026-06-28 02:00 UTC - 5% traffic, opt-in kernel-selection disabled.
  - Wave 2 (wider beta): 2026-06-28 14:00 UTC - 20% traffic, enable kernel-selection for non-short sequences.
  - Full ramp: 2026-06-30 - monitor KPI window 72 hours before declaring GA.
- Key metrics to watch (SLO owners assigned):
  - p50/p95/p99 latency per model family (Noor Singh)
  - memory usage and swap activity on Dedicated nodes (Liam O'Connor)
  - error rate and partial-streaming errors (Alex Morgan)
  - autoscaler thrash and insufficient-replicas (Daniel Chen)
- Rollback criteria: if p99 latency increases >25% over baseline for >30m OR memory usage increases consistent with previous leak pattern, initiate rollback to previous release and notify execs.

5) Blockers / open questions
- Cloud-ops approval for autoscaler infra changes still pending (ticket forwarded, Ben to escalate if not resolved by 2026-06-18).
- Need more synthetic workload coverage for very-short-sequence use cases (<16 tokens). Action: Alex to run targeted perf harness and report by 2026-06-18.
- CI flakiness observed in infra e2e (failing on GPU node teardown). Action: Samira to triage CI flakes and add more deterministic teardown steps (due 2026-06-22).

6) Action items (owners + due dates)
- Daniel Chen: add concurrent-cancel+eviction unit tests and submit PR (due 2026-06-23).
- Noor Singh: add eviction-ratelimit-high alert and test alert runbook (due 2026-06-20).
- Alex Morgan: targeted perf runs for short-sequence regression, provide report and recommendation for opt-in threshold (due 2026-06-18).
- Samira Gomez: triage infra CI flakes and stabilize teardown (due 2026-06-22).
- Ben Ruiz: escalate autoscaler infra approval if not approved by 2026-06-18; coordinate customer postmortem distribution (due 2026-06-18).
- Priya Patel: finalize release notes draft and coordinate signoff with PMs (due 2026-06-24).

Notes / Misc:
- Next meeting: weekly sync on 2026-06-23 09:00 UTC.
- Quick wins: consider enabling additional detailed logging only on canary nodes to reduce signal-to-noise in prod logs.
- Cross-team: coordinate with Product-hosted-api for messaging around streaming error codes; Alex to sync with PM on 2026-06-17.

Attachments / Links:
- Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/987
- Infra PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1123
- Postmortem / RCA (draft): JIRA-RE-4321
- Release plan doc: CONFLUENCE-RELEASE-PLANS-2026-06

End of notes.
